name: Alessandro Gheojan
headline: Computer Engineering Graduate & Telecommunications Engineering Student
pitch: I engineer reliable full-stack applications and cybersecurity solutions driven by discipline, continuous learning, and teamwork.

availability.text: Open to connecting with tech communities and engineering opportunities.

bio: I am a Computer Engineering graduate from Politecnico di Milano & ELIS, currently pursuing my studies in Telecommunications Engineering. Throughout my academic journey, I combined rigorous engineering coursework with hands-on, project-based engineering, delivering real-world software and cybersecurity solutions commissioned by consortium companies and startups.

Building on internship experiences across cyber risk governance, mobile development, and full-stack systems, I have developed strong end-to-end development and problem-solving skills, taking technical projects from concept to execution.
Beyond engineering, I am deeply passionate about calisthenics, applying the same discipline, consistency, and drive for growth to my physical fitness as I do to software craft.

experience.summary: Co-designed the SupplyGuard Intelligence Platform PoC for supply chain cyber risk management (NIS2 framework), building a 3-axis risk scoring engine and executive dashboards.
Developed a native Android application ported from a legacy Windows Mobile solution for handheld devices to support daily airport business operations.
Contributed front-end and back-end features using Spring Boot to improve staffing management tool functionality and usability.
Developed web applications with JavaScript, jQuery, HTML/CSS, and ASP.NET MVC.
Combined Politecnico di Milano computer engineering curriculum with practical industry projects commissioned by consortium companies.

education.title: High School Diploma in Computer Science & Telecommunications (100/100 cum laude)
